sentences.text: Regard being had to such facts and submissions, factum of permanent residence of the petitioners, nature of allegation, question of parity and substantial progress in the investigation, it is directed that the petitioners shall be released on bail by the Arresting Officer in the event of their arrest on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case including the conditions that i) the petitioner no.1 shall appear before the I.O. once in a week on the day and time fixed by the I.O. till the submission of F.F.; ii) the petitioner no. 2
being a lady shall appear before the I.O. for the purpose of investigation as and when required.
6. Within 21 days of the receipt of server copy or certified copy of this order, each of the petitioners are directed to appear before the I.O along with a copy of this order.
7. Accordingly, the prayer for the anticipatory bail is allowed.
8. The application being C.R.M. (A) 2184 of 2023 is disposed of.

(Chitta Ranjan Dash, J.) (Partha Sarathi Sen, J.)
